race.title: BAR 1 Betting 'Download Our App' For Auction Novice Hurdle (Grade 3)
race.verdict: THINKITDONTJINXIT made an impressive start over hurdles at Galway last month, travelling and jumping well before quickening clear from the home turn, and he is fancied to cope with the step up in grade, with City of Cork feared most after creating a taking impression on his return at Clonmel and hurdling debutant It's Only A Game and recent Gowran scorer The Captain's Word also respected. THINKITDONTJINXIT (IRE) CITY OF CORK (IRE) IT'S ONLY A GAME (FR)
